one_line: Imperial official overseeing multi-faith coinage in the Kushan Empire, c. 1st–2nd century CE across Bactria, Gandhara, Kapisa and Mathura.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, average height
appearance.face: oval face with prominent nose and high cheekbones, medium-olive Gandhara-Bactrian complexion, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, sharp observant eyes with a calm calculating expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair cut short to medium length, combed back from the forehead, wearing a soft rounded Kushan cap in deep maroon wool with a narrow golden trim at the edge
appearance.costume: knee-length, long-sleeved Kushan tunic of soft undyed off-white wool, belted at the waist with a narrow leather belt; over it a sleeveless, front-opening coat in muted indigo dyed wool with simple vertical woven borders in dull gold; straight, slightly loose trousers in warm sand-brown cotton tucked into mid-calf leather boots in dark brown; a light shawl in pale cream draped from the left shoulder across the chest when outdoors, and a simple metal ring on one hand to signal official status; overall cut reflects Central Asian steppe influence blended with Gandharan urban style, with no ornate royal regalia.
appearance.signature: a slightly oversized Kushan silver coin held between his fingers, showing a standing king on one side and a haloed deity with Bactrian legend on the other, plus a simple bronze die and a small short-handled hammer tucked at his belt as minting tools.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Kushan Mint Master with an oval olive-toned face, short black hair and trimmed beard, maroon rounded cap, off-white tunic, indigo sleeveless coat, sand-brown trousers, dark brown boots, and a Kushan silver coin with minting tools in a palette of off-white, indigo, maroon, sand-brown, dark brown, and dull gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style Kushan Mint Master: mid-30s, lean, oval olive-toned face with prominent nose, high cheekbones, neat short black hair combed back, trimmed beard and moustache, calm calculating eyes. He wears a deep maroon rounded wool cap with narrow golden trim, a knee-length off-white long-sleeved wool tunic belted with a simple leather belt, and a muted indigo sleeveless front-opening coat with subtle dull-gold vertical woven borders. His straight sand-brown cotton trousers tuck into mid-calf dark brown leather boots, and a pale cream shawl is lightly draped from his left shoulder across his chest. On one hand is a plain metal ring. In his right hand he prominently holds a slightly oversized detailed Kushan silver coin, with a standing king on one side and a haloed deity with Bactrian legend on the other, while a small bronze die and short-handled hammer sit visibly at his belt as minting tools. Use a colour palette dominated by off-white, indigo, maroon, sand-brown, dark brown, and dull gold, keeping the look historically grounded in Kushan Bactria-Gandhara urban attire with shonen-anime energy but dignified and scholarly rather than exaggerated.
